report: AFERR, you are 2-7 and scored 72.26 last week against gavinzteam's 88.6. Nobody in your lineup is hurt, and the lineup is already the best one available, so there are no start or sit changes. Cooper Jr., McConkey and Strong are all Out, so your real bench is thin. Quarterback is the biggest hole: Stafford averages 15.87 with a floor of 9.12 and has slipped to 12.33 over his last 3. Send the Josh Allen offer to daddyisback8 first, then the Stroud, Swift, Kittle and Cousins offers. Several offers reuse the same players (White, Flournoy, Dell, Stevenson, Mayer), so send one at a time and see who answers.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 15.87 and has a 9.12 floor, with a last-3 of 12.33. That is a bottom-half starter.
Javonte Williams is strong at 17.73 with 23 carries a game. Rachaad White is weak at 9.74, and the bench backs (Black 4.71, McGowan 3.63) are not starters.
Higgins averages 19.98 (28.17 over his last 3) and McMillan 15.56. Nobody behind them covers an injury or a bad week.
LaPorta averages 11.64 but only 5.5 over his last 3. His matchup is good (NE is 26th against TE), and Mayer at 9.09 is the backup.
Jameson Williams (13.21) faces a tough NE defense, ranked 2nd against WR. Stevenson (12.63) has a great matchup against DET, ranked 30th against RB.
Cooper Jr., McConkey and Strong are Out. The remaining healthy pieces average under 10 PPR points.

plan: Upgrade QB. Josh Allen (25.09, floor 17.8) or Stroud (20.51, floor 16.48) is worth +4.6 to +9 PPR points a week.
Swap White for D'Andre Swift (17.09) to fix the weak RB2 slot. He is on a bye this week, so he helps from next week.
Move LaPorta and a spare WR for Kittle (14.29, floor 8.36) to steady TE, then use waivers to refill the WR bench.
